description: This file defines the PagerManagerInterface interface for managing pagers in Drupal, including methods for creating, retrieving, and updating pagers, as well as handling pager element IDs and current page calculations.

classes.name: PagerManagerInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing pagers, including creation, retrieval, and page calculations.

methods.name: createPager
methods.description: Initializes a new pager with total items, items per page, and optional element ID.

methods.name: getPager
methods.description: Retrieves a pager object from static cache by element ID.

methods.name: findPage
methods.description: Returns the current requested page number for a given pager ID.

methods.name: getUpdatedParameters
methods.description: Adjusts URL query parameters to point to a specific page for a given pager element.

methods.name: getMaxPagerElementId
methods.description: Returns the maximum pager element ID, or -1 if none.

methods.name: reservePagerElementId
methods.description: Reserves a pager element ID to prevent collisions.
